title: Connecting Residents to Their Territory: Better Planning Intermodality Through Data Visualization
description:
Environmental urgency forces us to rethink transport networks. We need to break down the silos that isolate data from each mode of transport and approach mobility as the interconnection of multiple networks rather than a holistic system.

These new demands are renewing urban planning: How can we design interconnectivity? How do we place the travelling citizen at the heart of network design? How can we envision the territory as a mesh?

They call for creating new tools like Modality, which models and visualizes the connection between residents and their territory.

--

Caroline Goulard. CEO, Dataveyes

Ever since the completion of her studies in journalism, Caroline has been nurturing a passion for how information can be expressed, shared and understood. In 2010, sensing that the rich data era will transform the way we work, learn and communicate, she co-founded Dataveyes.
